review.note: Summary drafted in M41b from the two cached leads, which say no more than this. It reaches the atlas through the relation that says Franco led it, and so through the election of 5 April 1908 — held nine weeks after the regicide and the fall of his ministry, and already in the atlas with him named as its outgoing head of government.

summary: The Liberal Regenerator Party, formally the Centro Regenerador Liberal, was founded on 16 May 1901 by João Franco after he broke with Hintze Ribeiro, then leader of the Regenerator Party.
